# apple_subscription_introductory_offers (Data Source)

Lists the introductory offer records of an auto-renewable subscription — one per territory, the way Apple keeps them, whoever made them.

This is how an offer made in App Store Connect is found: its record IDs are what `apple_subscription_introductory_offer` imports from (`<subscription_id>/<offer_id>`), and Apple publishes no `GET` for a single offer, so the subscription's collection is the only place they appear. It is also how to see what already occupies a territory — a territory holds one introductory offer at a time, and an overlapping one is refused.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every introductory offer record on a subscription, one per territory --
# including ones made in App Store Connect, whose IDs are what
# apple_subscription_introductory_offer imports from.
data "apple_subscription_introductory_offers" "pro_monthly" {
  subscription_id = "6740021496"
}

# Narrowed by territory (applied by Apple) and by mode.
data "apple_subscription_introductory_offers" "trials_in_europe" {
  subscription_id = "6740021496"
  territories     = ["GBR", "DEU", "FRA"]
  offer_mode      = "FREE_TRIAL"
}

output "offer_ids_by_territory" {
  value = {
    for offer in data.apple_subscription_introductory_offers.pro_monthly.introductory_offers :
    offer.territory_id => offer.id...
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subscription_id` (String) The ID of the subscription whose introductory offers to list.

### Optional

- `offer_mode` (String) Return only records of this mode: `FREE_TRIAL`, `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` or `PAY_UP_FRONT`. Applied in memory.
- `territories` (Set of String) Three-letter Apple territory codes to restrict the listing to, for example `["USA", "GBR"]`. Applied by Apple, not in memory.

### Read-Only

- `introductory_offers` (Attributes List) The matching records, ordered by territory and then start date. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--introductory_offers))
- `total_count` (Number) Number of records Apple returned before the in-memory `offer_mode` filter.

<a id="nestedatt--introductory_offers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `introductory_offers`

Read-Only:

- `duration` (String) How long one period of the offer lasts, for example `ONE_WEEK`.
- `end_date` (String) The last date the offer is available, or null for one with no end.
- `id` (String) The Apple ID of the record.
- `number_of_periods` (Number) How many periods the offer runs for.
- `offer_mode` (String) `FREE_TRIAL`, `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` or `PAY_UP_FRONT`.
- `price_point_id` (String) The price point a paid offer charges in this territory. Null for a free trial.
- `start_date` (String) The date the offer becomes available, or null for one available from creation.
- `target_subscription_plan_type` (String) `MONTHLY` or `UPFRONT` when the offer targets one plan of the subscription; null otherwise.
- `territory_id` (String) The three-letter Apple territory code the record applies in. Null when Apple reports none.
